E2-2023-T4-P1-S4.trunk: S+V+C：Children become independent people（儿童会变成独立的人）
structure: └ 定语从句(who)：who have relied on grown-ups for just about everything
└ 定语从句(who)：who can take care of themselves and help each other
E2-2023-T4-P1-S4.logic: 两个 who 从句分别刻画变化前后的儿童：此前几乎事事依赖成人，之后能够自理并互助；主干 become 把两种状态连接起来。
notes: just about everything 意为几乎所有事情。
take care of themselves 在此指独立照顾自己。

E2-2023-T4-P1-S11.trunk: S+V+O：The participants filled out questionnaires（参与者填写问卷）
structure: 主句：The participants filled out questionnaires
└ 介词宾语从句：about how often they did things
├ 定语从句1(that)：that were altruistic and positive
│   └ 举例：like sacrificing their own interests to help a friend
└ 并列省略：or [things that were] rebellious and negative
└ 举例：like getting drunk or staying out late
E2-2023-T4-P1-S11.logic: how often 从句说明问卷内容；后面用 or 对举积极与消极行为，两边各用 like 举例，第二边省略重复的 things that were。
notes: fill out a questionnaire 表示填写问卷。
sacrifice A to do B 表示为做B而牺牲A。

E2-2023-T4-P1-S23.trunk: S+V：Reward sensitivity seems to go up and then down（奖赏敏感性似乎先上升后下降）
structure: 插入比较：like prosocial behavior and risk-taking
谓语：seems to go up in adolescence
并列变化(and then)：and then down again as we age
E2-2023-T4-P1-S23.logic: like 插入语把奖赏敏感性与另外两种行为联系起来；go up...and then down...呈现随年龄变化的倒U形轨迹。
notes: down 前省略与 go up 平行的 go。
as we age 意为随着年龄增长。
